moments.title: Bake Off Returns with Nigella Lawson
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off, series 17, premieres on Channel 4 on Tuesday with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a new judge, replacing Prue Leith.

angles.name: Nigella's debut
angles.copy: The tent is back open! Get ready for soggy bottoms and showstoppers as The Great British Bake Off returns tomorrow night, with a brand new judge in Nigella Lawson. Will she bring the heat or a gentle simmer? #GBBO

angles.name: Bake Off is back
angles.copy: New judge, same delicious drama! The Great British Bake Off kicks off its 17th series tomorrow on Channel 4. Who's your favourite to win the coveted cake stand this year?

moments.title: Strictly Live Shows Begin
moments.blurb: After Saturday's launch show, the first live episode of Strictly Come Dancing 2026 airs this weekend, with new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe presiding over the celebrity pairings.

angles.name: Live show excitement
angles.copy: Get ready to cha-cha-cha! The Strictly Come Dancing live shows begin this Saturday. Who are you rooting for to lift the Glitterball trophy this year?

angles.name: New hosts in action
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are officially in! The new Strictly hosts kick off the live shows this Saturday, bringing a fresh sparkle to the ballroom. What do you think of the new line-up?

moments.title: Autumn Equinox Marks Official Start of Fall
moments.blurb: The Autumnal Equinox occurred in the UK at 1:06 AM BST on September 23, officially marking the start of astronomical autumn in the Northern Hemisphere.

angles.name: Hello Autumn
angles.copy: Crisp air, golden leaves, and pumpkin spice everything! The Autumnal Equinox arrived at 1:06 AM BST yesterday, officially kicking off the new season. What's your favourite thing about autumn?

angles.name: Seasonal change
angles.copy: Longer nights and shorter days are officially here! The Autumn Equinox has passed, bringing astronomical autumn to the UK. Time to dig out those cosy jumpers!

moments.title: Harvest Moon Illuminates Skies
moments.blurb: The Harvest Moon, the full moon closest to the autumnal equinox, will be full on Saturday, September 26th, at 12:49 PM EDT (or 5:49 PM BST), appearing full on both Friday and Saturday nights.

angles.name: Harvest Moon weekend
angles.copy: Look up this weekend! The spectacular Harvest Moon will be full on Saturday, lighting up the night sky. Perfect for an autumnal evening stroll.

angles.name: Moon magic
angles.copy: The Harvest Moon is nearly here! Catch its glow this Friday and Saturday night as it reaches its peak fullness. Who's planning to stargaze?

moments.title: Gallagher Premiership Rugby Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Gallagher Premiership Rugby season begins this Friday, September 25th, with Harlequins vs Bath and Northampton Saints vs Newcastle Red Bulls.

angles.name: Rugby's Back!
angles.copy: Get ready for the new season! The Gallagher Premiership Rugby kicks off this Friday. Which team are you backing for glory this year?

angles.name: Friday Night Lights
angles.copy: Premiership Rugby returns with two big clashes this Friday night! Harlequins take on Bath, and Northampton Saints face Newcastle Red Bulls. Who's watching?

moments.title: Exeter Chiefs Start Season at Home
moments.blurb: Exeter Chiefs begin their 2026/27 Gallagher Premiership Rugby campaign at Sandy Park against Gloucester Rugby on Saturday, September 26th.

angles.name: Chiefs are back!
angles.copy: Big game this Saturday! Exeter Chiefs kick off their Premiership season at Sandy Park against Gloucester Rugby. Get down and support the lads!

angles.name: Local Rugby Returns
angles.copy: Devon, are you ready? The Chiefs are back in action this Saturday for their first Gallagher Premiership match of the season at home. Let's make some noise!

moments.title: Formula 1 Azerbaijan Grand Prix
moments.blurb: The Formula 1 Qatar Airways Azerbaijan Grand Prix takes place this Saturday, September 26th, with the main race at noon UK time on the Baku City Circuit.

angles.name: F1 in Baku
angles.copy: Lights out in Baku! The F1 Azerbaijan Grand Prix is this Saturday. Who's your pick for the win on the streets of Baku?

angles.name: Saturday Race Day
angles.copy: Unusually, the Azerbaijan Grand Prix is on a Saturday this week! Tune in at noon UK time for all the high-speed action. #AzerbaijanGP

moments.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
moments.blurb: Iconic Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Still definitely, maybe a rock 'n' roll star at 54! Celebrating the birthday of Liam Gallagher today. Play your favourite Oasis anthem loud!

angles.name: Timeless Voice
angles.copy: Celebrating the timeless voice of Faith Hill on her 59th birthday today. Send us your favourite song by the country legend!

angles.name: Eagles Legend's Birthday

angles.name: Hotel California icon
angles.copy: From 'Hotel California' to a solo career, celebrating Don Felder's 79th birthday today! A true guitar hero.

angles.name: Still a rebel

angles.name: Medicine Head Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating the 79th birthday of Peter Hope-Evans next Monday! Best known for Medicine Head's 'One and One is One'. What a track!
